name: Villarrica volcano summit
why: Climb an active volcano on snow with crampons and look into a smoking crater, Lake Villarrica far below.
book: Only with a certified guide (CONAF rule); agencies in Pucón provide crampons, axe, helmet and gas mask. The summit closes whenever the volcanic alert rises.
dangers: Volcanic gas at the crater rim: the gas mask is not optional.
Hard snow and ice: crampons and ice axe.
Climbs are cancelled the same morning for wind.
turnaround: Your guide decides; most groups turn back at 13:00 wherever they are.

points.name: Villarrica ski centre
points.note: About 1,400 m. A chairlift saves the first 400 m when it runs.

points.name: Villarrica snow slopes above Lake Villarrica
points.note: Crampons on: zigzag up the snow, the lake and Pucón below.

points.name: Villarrica crater rim
points.note: 2,847 m. The crater smokes; on a lucky day you hear the lava.
